name: Chixia

tierList.prydwen: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 4-star free Fusion Pistols DPS with one of the highest-multiplier Ultimates in the game. Forte gauge 'Thermobaric Bullets' (max 60) built via Basics/Intro/Skill, channeled via held Resonance Skill 'DAKA DAKA!' (ideally exactly 30 bullets) then finished with Basic Attack into 'Boom Boom' nuke.

skills.resonanceSkill: Whizzing Fight Spirit (2 charges) - hold to enter DAKA DAKA! channel consuming Thermobaric Bullets, finished by Basic Attack into Boom Boom.
skills.forte: Heroic Bullets - governs Thermobaric Bullets and the DAKA DAKA!/Boom Boom sequence.
skills.liberation: Blazing Flames - AoE Fusion DMG, tied for highest Energy cost among damage dealers.
skills.intro: Grand Entrance - rapid dual-pistol Fusion DMG.
skills.outro: Leaping Flames - AoE Fusion DMG equal to 530% ATK.

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Brant amplifies Chixia's Fusion and Skill DMG (20%/25%) while contributing his own damage.

teams.name: Changli Dual DPS Team
teams.notes: Chixia is currently the character that best exploits Changli's short Outro buff; moderately difficult quickswap playstyle.

rotation: Warm-up: Skill x2 (swap-cancelled) to pre-build Forte + Energy. Burst: Echo -> Intro -> DAKA DAKA! (30 bullets) -> Boom Boom -> Ultimate -> DAKA DAKA! -> Boom Boom -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: free, easy-to-understand ranged DPS best played as a Dual-DPS partner (especially with Changli) rather than solo Main DPS, since her own field time is inefficient outside her Forte channel and Ultimate; weak AoE, near-impossible to parry (gun class), and precise 30-bullet timing on DAKA DAKA! is tricky and interruption-prone.
